renameHelp.link: How do I use Smart rename?
renameHelp.title: Help OpenSubtitles recognize your video
renameHelp.reason: Cue builds subtitle searches from video filenames. If a query is rejected or no reliable subtitle is found, a clearer filename with the English movie or series title may help.
renameHelp.select: Close this guide, open the folder containing the failed video, and select it. For a batch, select only videos from the same movie or series.
renameHelp.choose: Open the arrow menu beside the subtitle action button and choose “Smart rename”. Then click “Rename files”.
renameHelp.titleStep: Enter the English movie or series title, for example “Game of Thrones”, and confirm. The AI uses this title while keeping episode, year, quality, and extension details when present.
renameHelp.retry: Wait for renaming to finish, select the renamed videos, and use the arrow menu to choose a subtitle format again. Click “Create subtitles” (or “Add to queue”) to retry.
renameHelp.note: Smart rename changes the video filenames and matching subtitle filenames. It may improve the query, but does not guarantee that OpenSubtitles will accept it or find subtitles.

rename.help: The AI will keep episode, year, quality, and extension details when they are present.
